title: Disney Animated Series Banned Following Successful Release
content: While series like Amphibia, The Owl House , and Gravity Falls don’t have any new animated episodes planned. this fact isn’t stopping Disney from creating wild new animated series to its roster.
author: ComicBook

title: Fall in Love, You False Angels TV Anime Announced for 2027
content: Coco Uzuki’s award-winning romance manga Fall in Love, You False Angels is officially receiving a TV anime adaptation, with the series scheduled to premiere in 2027. The manga follows Otogi Katsura, a girl admired by everyone around her as the perfect high school beauty.
author: Anime Corner

title: All the Astronauts Assemble in Dr. Stone Final Season Updated Climax Visual
content: Dr. Stone: Science Future (Season 4) Cour 3 (final) revealed the full version of the climax visual featuring all the astronauts from Earth. The anime premiered on April 2 , with Shuhei Matsushuita directing at TMS Entertainment. Previously, a climax visual featuring Senku alone was revealed.
author: Anime Corner

title: Fluffy Paradise Light Novel Series Listed as Ending in 21st Volume
content: Online retailers are listing the 21st novel volume of Himawari and Kirouran 's Fluffy Paradise ( Isekai de Mofumofu Nadenade Suru Tameni Ganbattemasu ) novel series as the final volume. The volume will ship on August 10.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Yamaguchi-kun Isn't So Bad Film Opens at #6
content: The Super Mario Galaxy Movie — Nintendo , Illumination , and Universal Pictures ' sequel to The Super Mario Bros. Movie — stayed at #2 in its seventh weekend. The film sold 115,000 tickets and earned 157,473,010 yen (about US$980,900) from Friday to Sunday.
author: ANN

title: Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky New Trailer Reveals Opening Theme Song
content: The new trailer for the upcoming Love Unseen Beneath the Clear Night Sky anime revealed the opening theme song “Hitohira” by Motohiro Hata. The anime premieres on July 6. title: Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You Anime's 2nd Trailer Unveils Opening Song, July 9 TV Debut
content: The official website for the television anime of Jinushi 's Smoking Behind the Supermarket with You ( Super no Ura de Yani Sū Futari ) manga revealed on Thursday the anime's second main promotional video and July 9 television debut in Japan.
author: ANN

title: New Ghost in the Shell by Science SARU Reveals MILLENNIUM PARADE Ending Theme in Trailer
content: The new THE GHOST IN THE SHELL TV anime by Science SARU revealed the fourth teaser trailer introducing the ending theme song. The anime was previously confirmed for a July 7 premiere date, with Amazon Prime Video set to stream it.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Ghost in the Shell Anime's 4th Promo Video Reveals Ending Song
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks revealed on Thursday the fourth promotional video for Science SARU 's The Ghost in the Shell ( Kōkaku Kidōtai THE GHOST IN THE SHELL ) television anime series. The video reveals and previews the anime's ending theme song "Blue" by MILLENNIUM PARADE feat. Saya Gray, Daniel Caesar.
author: ANN

title: Thunder 3 TV Anime Reveals Ending Song, July 8 Debut in New Video
content: The official website for the television anime of Yuki Ikeda 's Thunder 3 manga revealed on Wednesday the anime's second promotional video and July 8 debut. The video also reveals and previews the ending theme song "Shururerira" by -otoha- .
author: ANN
